page_title: GEN 0-2 VER | Genoa v Verona 01/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' Genoa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+1' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Lorenzo Montipo comes off the line to clear the ball away.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.

89' A short pass finds Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
87' We are about to witness a substitution. Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) is replacing Ondrej Duda.
87' Here is a change. Darko Lazovic is going off and Paolo Zanetti gives the last tactical orders to Domagoj Bradaric (Verona).
86' Alberto Gilardino prepares a substitution. Junior Messias is replaced by Federico Accornero (Genoa).
85' A pass from Junior Messias (Genoa) is intercepted by Lorenzo Montipo and the move breaks down.
84' Substitution. Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) in, Morten Frendrup out.
81' Reda Belahyane (Verona) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
79' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
79' The game has begun to heat up. Ondrej Duda (Verona) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
77' Reda Belahyane (Verona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Giovanni Ayroldi had an easy-decision to make.

76' How did he miss! The cross loops over the keeper leaving Darko Lazovic (Verona) with an empty net, but somehow he heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
75' Dangerous play by Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa). Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul.
75' Wonderful movement by Genoa. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
73' It is time for a substitution. Daniel Mosquera (Verona) is on for Casper Tengstedt.
70' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
65' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Casper Tengstedt (Verona) duly receives a yellow card.
64' 0 - 2 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Casper Tengstedt (Verona) high into the middle of the goal, giving goalkeeper Pierluigi Gollini no chance!
64' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) is going to take the penalty!
64' Referee Giovanni Ayroldi is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Genoa!
64' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Verona, he's going to review using VAR.
64' Handball! A player from Genoa handled the ball.
61' Paolo Zanetti has decided to substitute Abdou Harroui and he is replaced by Flavius Daniliuc (Verona).
61' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Tomas Suslov will be replaced by Grigoris Kastanos (Verona).
61' Alberto Gilardino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Morten Thorsby (Genoa) replacing Stefano Sabelli.
61' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Vitinha.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) comes onto the pitch for Milan Badelj.
59' Martin Frese (Verona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
57' The game is interrupted. Martin Frese (Verona) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.

55' 0 - 1 Darko Lazovic sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) latches on to it and finishes with a quick low shot into the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 0:1.

55' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Giovanni Ayroldi with no other option than to blow for a foul.

52' Junior Messias (Genoa) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the left post. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
50' Ondrej Duda (Verona) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
49' The yellow card is received by Koni De Winter (Genoa).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Giovanni Ayroldi has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Abdou Harroui (Verona) for his blatant foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' A long ball forward to Tomas Suslov (Verona) is intercepted.
44' Verona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
42' Martin Frese (Verona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
41' Martin Frese (Verona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
40' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Morten Frendrup (Genoa) was quite harsh and Giovanni Ayroldi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
39' Junior Messias (Genoa) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
38' Martin Frese (Verona) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
37' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
36' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
33' Abdou Harroui (Verona) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom left corner. Pierluigi Gollini is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
32' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) has tested the patience of referee Giovanni Ayroldi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
30' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Reda Belahyane (Verona), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.

29' What an opportunity! Johan Vasquez (Genoa) disappointed the fans as he smashed a first-time shot from inside the box against the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
21' The corner from Aaron Martin (Genoa) is cleared away by the defence.
20' Tomas Suslov (Verona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Giovanni Ayroldi had an easy-decision to make.

15' Junior Messias (Genoa) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom left corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.

14' Genoa slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
8' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul after Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) hacks down one of his opponents.
8' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Verona comes to nothing.
6' The game is interrupted now, Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
5' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) sends a cross into the box, but Lorenzo Montipo comes off his line to gather the ball.
3' Genoa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Genoa will have the kick-off.
Giovanni Ayroldi will referee today's match.
